description: This file defines the setup and configuration logic for the BlueBubbles channel integration within the OpenClaw framework, including setup wizard steps, validation, and configuration application.

methods.name: parseBlueBubblesAllowFromInput
methods.description: Parses a raw string input into an array of allowlist entries, splitting by newline or comma.

methods.name: validateBlueBubblesAllowFromEntry
methods.description: Validates a single allowlist entry, ensuring it is a valid handle or chat target.

methods.name: validateBlueBubblesServerUrlInput
methods.description: Validates the server URL input, ensuring it is a properly formatted URL.

methods.name: applyBlueBubblesSetupPatch
methods.description: Applies configuration patches to the BlueBubbles setup, updating server URL, password, or webhook path.

methods.name: resolveBlueBubblesServerUrl
methods.description: Resolves the current server URL from the configuration.

methods.name: resolveBlueBubblesWebhookPath
methods.description: Resolves the current webhook path from the configuration.

methods.name: validateBlueBubblesWebhookPath
methods.description: Validates the webhook path ensuring it starts with a '/' and is not empty.
